question.text: An IPO subscription period must remain open for a minimum of how many working days?

explanation.text: The Logic: Under SEBI ICDR Regulations, an IPO must remain open for subscription for at least 3 working days and not more than 10 working days. In the event of a price-band revision, the subscription period is extended by at least 3 additional working days, subject to the overall 10-working-day maximum. The Trap: 1 working day is below the regulatory floor. 5 and 7 working days are common assumptions but are not the prescribed minimum; the minimum is specifically 3 working days.
